_accepted_risks.what: Pre-remediation PTSleeveStrategy.completeInbound books retFace6 but does NOT consume inFlight6 (zeroing it is a separate keeper ackArrival). A forgotten/failed ack leaves a returned inbound counted TWICE (idle cash AND still-'in-flight') -> totalAssets() reports up to 2x the real money (false-HIGH book that masks a shortfall). R-1 (un-swept realized yield bridgeable back to the venue) is also unfixed live. Source: docs/PT_SLEEVE_REMEDIATION_2026-10-05.md (F-1 HIGH, 'remains LIVE until redeployed'); bytecode sweep t_edbb5fb7.
_accepted_risks.loss_bound_2026-10-10: Per-lane overstatement = the un-acked inbound amount, bounded by that lane's outstanding sent face; reported totalAssets() can reach up to 2x real for that lane. Measured live 2026-10-10 (t_c6e22ed9): PT-Arb 0x2D3E5bf1 = $0 (lane flat, fully unwound 2026-10-09; inFlight6=0, arbValue6=0, totalAssets=0); PT-ETH 0xA96D0BB2 = up to $18.953737 (sent face; arbValue6 $18.959029, inFlight6=0 -> no active phantom) -> vault book $126.269032 could be overstated by up to ~$18.95 (+15%) in the worst case. NOT a direct money loss: it is a book overstatement realizable only by overpaying a withdrawing depositor.
_accepted_risks.compensating_controls: scripts/pt_phantom_check.js (Check A exact-phantom: inFlight6>0 AND sentFace6-retFace6==0) runs every 10 min via vault_watch_mainnet.js; alert remedy = keeper ackArrival (a bookkeeping ack, NOT a money movement). No active phantom on either lane 2026-10-10 (inFlight6=0 both).
_accepted_risks.gate: NO NEW TVL into 0x2D3E5bf1 / 0xA96D0BB2 (no keeper deployToArb/pushIdle into them) until the remediated pair is registered. Both old strategies remain registered+ACTIVE, so vault.allocate() (owner/Safe-only) would split new deposits into them -> enforce by not allocating to the PT lanes (or setStrategyActive(false)) until the remediated pair is registered.
_accepted_risks.code_gate_2026-10-10: ENFORCED IN CODE (kanban t_48438e79). scripts/pt_strategy_gate.js is the single source: the pre-remediation set {0x2D3E5bf1, 0xA96D0BB2} is hard-fail and only the remediated allowlist {0xd7075C9B, 0x9238320C} may ever be activated. deposit_chain_auto.cjs refuses the whole chain (exit 1) while either old lane is registered+ACTIVE and only activates an allowlisted+registered PT; pt_keeper_core.js refuses deployToArb (funding) into a pre-remediation lane (unwind actions still served); pt_loop.js STAGE=seed/deploy assert-not-pre-remediation; susd3_first_cycle.sh refuses (exit 3) because its active-set restore would re-activate the old lanes. Verified live 2026-10-10 (both old active=true) -> deposit chain REFUSING/exit 1, susd3 DRY REFUSED/exit 3. deposit-chain.timer stays disabled.
_accepted_risks.resolution: Register the remediated pair (Arb 0xd7075C9BD95649b3d6831182bea2986552097A2f / ETH 0x9238320Cc802863c7c1d78D1aaA6cbe0F7975092; deployed 2026-10-05 with the F-1/F-5/yield-split + R-1 source) at the per-lane unwind boundary: Arb already unwound 2026-10-09 (lane flat, re-point unblocked); ETH matures ~2026-11-05. Registration is a vault-owner (Safe) action. SHORT-TERM CONTAINMENT EXECUTED 2026-10-10 — both old lanes are now strategyActive=false (see onchain_lock_2026-10-10), so vault.allocate() can no longer reach them.
